title: A career archive and separate applications
description: Detailed experience is kept for years, and the part that fits a posting is picked out of it.

blocks.text: Nobody wants to type the places they worked in again for every application. And one short document has no room for the whole history.

quote.text: I love this App and always come back to it whenever I need a quick and easy CV. It has a great yet structured layout.

blocks.text: Separate the main profile from the versions of the resume. Add new events without changing old files that have already been sent.
Changing the template and removing a section from an application shouldn’t wipe the original data. A history of edits and an independent export of the archive both help.
